column3: Close to the Hebrew; “call with the throat” is rendered “Cry aloud.”
Close to the Hebrew; “judgments of righteousness” is rendered “the ordinances of justice.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “they say,” and “drive hard” is rendered “exploit.”
Close to the Hebrew; “contention” is rendered “debate.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the bindings of the yoke-bar” is rendered “the heavy burdens.”
Close to the Hebrew; “break” is rendered “share,” and “homeless” “cast out.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the stretching out of a finger” is rendered “The pointing of the finger.”
Close to the Hebrew; “offer your soul” is rendered “extend your soul,” and “gloom” “darkness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “paths” is rendered “Streets,” and NKJV capitalizes the titles.
Close to the Hebrew; “honor it” is rendered “honor Him,” and “to speak a word” “speaking your own words.”
Close to the Hebrew; “high places of the land” is rendered “high hills of the earth.”
